title: handshake_timeout checked the connection before the refused attempt ended, racing two 5 s timeouts
summary: handshake_timeout arms a silent MODNAME reply and asserts !context.connected right after connect_focuser() returns false. connect_focuser() gives up after 5 s, the same time the unanswered read takes, so the CONNECTION property can still be BUSY with CONNECTED on. On Linux it failed in all 5 runs (before and after the library extraction, with and without FND-000049 fixed); the macOS records pass.

resolution.evidence: 20261022212521-61cf-primalucelib/verification.md: the case waits for CONNECTION ALERT before checking that the device is not connected; 3 of 3 isolated reruns and the recorded run pass.
